text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Creek-san was constantly helping me out...
*sigh* How pathetic.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I want to be independent... for real...

At the riverbank, I spotted Narita Taishin staring fixedly at a single spot.
Curious, I followed her gaze—

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Like I said~. We're still pissed off about it. You get me?

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah. We haven't forgotten how you punched us out for no reason when we were little. Apologize already, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I am truly sorry for my actions back then.
I caused you trouble due to my own immaturity, and I apologize from the bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you're actually bowing your head~?
And here I thought if you tried to swing at us, we'd beat you to a pulp~.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
All I can do now is demonstrate my sincerity.
Resorting to violence is completely out of the question.

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: ............Whatever. Dealing with someone like this is a waste of time. Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: What was that about...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: She just let them talk down to her and push her around. Why—

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Ah-ha-ha, Taishin's shoe flew right up into the tree~.
You're so short, what're you gonna do now~?

text_block_list.name: Young Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Screw you!
I'm gonna kick your butt...!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek!
Taishin-chan is mad!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Why didn't you fight back?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Ah, regarding that incident just now?
I apologize for showing you such an unsightly display.
choice_data_list: Should I have stepped in to help?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No. It remains a fact that I hurt them in the past.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Still, if you don't push back, they're just gonna keep walking all over you.
Those jerks... might even come back again.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: An outlaw who surrendered herself to "raging fire" and threw around her strength... That was the young child named Yaeno Muteki.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Rampaging selfishly, dragging others down, and causing nothing but trouble—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: However, through my grandfather and the Kongo Yaegaki Style, I was taught what true martial arts and propriety mean, allowing me to change.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Yaeno—to find your own path, you must broaden your perspective.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Turn your eyes not only toward yourself, but toward your surroundings, and set the path you must walk.
Only then will you see the manner of existence you ought to seek.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Taking those words to heart and continuing forward—I finally set my sights upon the path of racing.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Now, I no longer exert force recklessly, and I believe I have learned... at least some degree of consideration for those around me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Walking your own path... without causing trouble for anyone.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I wonder if that's what independence really means.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Broadening your perspective, and looking not just at yourself, but at those around you... huh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I... can't hold back like Yaeno does.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: If someone messes with me, I'll definitely strike back. I hate being looked down on. But—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Broadening my perspective, and looking at those around me instead of just myself... If I don't do that, I probably won't ever be able to change.
